method: Arithmetic mean of reported per-match accuracy for the winning scoreboard row; pooled hits/shots shown separately; range +/-7.5 percentage points.
limitations: A score winner is not independently verified player identity
Accuracy is not damage per bullet
Gauntlet, splash and shotgun pellet semantics differ; do not calibrate by raw hit quotient alone
Aiming profile parameters do not guarantee achieved accuracy; live calibration required
